definitions.distinctValue: Canonical rgb plus alpha after parsing. Token and palette classes resolve to their dark-mode value.
definitions.offToken: No token has this rgb at any alpha. Includes values within nearDelta of a token, which are near misses, not matches.
definitions.signature: Sorted visual utilities (colour, border, radius, shadow, type) in a className, ignoring layout and breakpoints.

limitations: Class names assembled at runtime are not resolved. See dynamicClasses.
String constants resolve for className signatures only when declared in the same file.
Component roles match by name and class pattern, so a pattern that looks like a card but is not one can count.

modal.sameRoleNote: Every entry shows a blocking layer over the page for one task.

card.sameRoleNote: Container for one title, event, or list item.

button.sameRoleNote: A control that performs one action.

implementations.name: hand-rolled tab state (setActiveTab, setTab, setFilter, setView)

emptyState.sameRoleNote: What a screen shows when it has nothing.

loading.sameRoleNote: What a screen shows while it waits.

poster.sameRoleNote: One film or show's poster image.
